caseName: Pope v. Atlantic Coast Line Railroad
caseNameFull: Pope v. Atlantic Coast Line Railroad Co.
attorneys: Richard M. Maxwell and Thomas J. Lewis for petitioners., Charles Cook Howell and Douglas W. Matthews for respondent.

opinions.text: Supreme Court of Georgia. Certiorari granted. Counsel are requested to discuss in their briefs and on oral argument the question whether the judgment sought to be reviewed is final within the meaning of 28 U. S. C. § 1257.
